comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
English name is "Artemis's Temple's Past". Discovery from central part of "Ephesus the Land of Goddess" legacy. Lets you enter the new inland "Temple of Artemis in Ephesus". 650x Sophia and consumable "Decorative Small Boat Blueprint" each enter.

For those who want to try getting valuable items here, Very high Search will be likely needed.. because it's extremely hard to get everything beside Moonstone (trade goods), and Ancient Iron Meteorite, compared with older inland such as Halicarnassus and Great Pyramid of Giza.
